entries.title: Fewer pauses as tasks change when another computer runs your work
entries.body: With a computer that runs work on your list, the window could stop answering for a moment each time a task changed, while Infinitary recounted the tasks running on each computer. It now counts them from where each task runs, without rereading every running task in full.
entries.noPicture: Your devices and the task counts look the same; this removes repeated reading behind each computer's count.
